notes.title: Price Drop Announcement. New Price for New Captains!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Ahoy, Captains![/b][/h1][p]We have an important update to share. Starting today, [i]Void Sails[/i] is now available at a [b]reduced price[/b].[/p][p]This decision comes after listening closely to the feedback from our community. While many of you appreciated the game’s world, atmosphere, and story, we also heard the concerns about its length and scope. We agree - it’s only fair to align the price with the experience offered.[/p][p]But this is more than just a number change.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]We want more people to discover the journey.[/b][/h2][p]Lowering the price helps make [i]Void Sails[/i] more accessible to new players who may have been hesitant. We truly believe in the story we've told - and we want to open the doors wider for those who’d like to sail into the unknown.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]To our early supporters: you mean everything.[/b][/h2][p]If you’ve been with us since launch, thank you. Your support, reviews, and kind messages carried us through a difficult time - and continue to do so.[/p][p]We’re currently working on a new project. It’s still early, but we know we want to [b]honor our early captains[/b]. Whether it’s free access to the new game, exclusive closed beta invites, or even a tribute inside the game itself - we’re figuring out the best way to say thank you properly. Stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]From all of us at Ticking Clock Games:
 Thank you for believing in a small team with a big dream.
 We’re not done yet.
 — The [i]Void Sails[/i] Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1: Controller Support, Bug Fixes, and More
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We just wanted to take a moment to talk directly to all of you who’ve been playing, sharing feedback, and supporting our game since launch.

We’ve been reading every single comment, review, and discussion thread — seriously, all of them — and we’re incredibly grateful for how thoughtful and passionate this community already feels. It’s clear that despite a few bugs and rough edges, a lot of you are really connecting with the game, and that honestly means everything to us.

[h3]Controller support is now live!
[/h3]

This was one of the most requested features, and we wanted to get it in your hands as soon as possible. It’s something we had in the works, but your feedback really pushed it up the list.

[h3]Bug fixes have started rolling out.
[/h3]

We’ve already patched several minor issues, and we’re continuing to work through the rest. If you’ve reported something — thank you. We’re on it.

We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes — fixing bugs, improving things, and reading everything you’re saying. Your feedback is genuinely helping shape what we do next, and it’s been amazing to build this alongside such a passionate group of players.

If you haven’t yet, please hop into the Steam Discussions — we’d love to hear your thoughts, suggestions, or even just what parts of the game you’re enjoying.

It’s been amazing seeing so many of you sail trough the stars already! Your support and enthusiasm genuinely fuel us to keep going.

With gratitude,

Roman, Janusz and Carlos

notes.title: Post launch update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Captains![/h1]

This update features various small bug fixes and improvements.

We heard your reports about the game crashing, and are sorry for inconveniences and progress loss it might've caused. Unfortunately the bug hasn't been detected for a long time, as it happens randomly, usually
after 1,5h+ of gameplay. The hardware also seems to be a factor, as part of the dev team never experienced a
single crash, even after playing the game through and through. With this update, we push a change that might
[b]prevent crashes from happening[/b], but we can't be sure due to the random nature of the bug. We do want
push this change now, as it's non intrusive and we want you to be able to enjoy the game without crashing as
soon as possible. In the event that crashes still occur frequently, we will investigate further.

Please, feel free to share your thoughts and opinions in the comments below, or on the steam's Discussions page. We are a very small team, but we try to regularly reply to your comments and suggestions and would like to hear more from you!

[h3]Safe voyages and good luck![/h3]

notes.title: Demo Official Release
notes.notes:
After weeks of intense playtests, countless iterations, and an incredible amount of insightful feedback from players like you, we’ve been hard at work refining, balancing, and improving every aspect of the game. Today, we’re beyond excited to finally share the results—the VOID Sails demo is officially live! 🎉

🔥 What’s New in the Demo?

✅ Enhanced Combat – Weapons rebalanced, enemy AI improved, and ship battles feel more intense than ever!
✅ Refined Story & Choices – We’ve polished dialogue, improved pacing, and added more meaningful player decisions.
✅ Improved demo flow– Rearranged the locations you visit and the cave area to enhance player experience!.
✅ Bug Fixes & Performance Boosts – Thanks to your reports, the game runs better across all tested systems!

Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’d love to hear your thoughts on the demo! What do you love? What could be even better? Let us know! 🚀

Thanks for being part of this journey—this is just the beginning. See you among the stars!
